doc.brief: The QColormap class maps device independent QColors to device dependent pixel values.
doc.index_brief: Maps device independent QColors to device dependent pixel values

QColormap instance(int screen).brief: Returns the colormap for the specified *screen*.

QColormap::Mode mode() const.brief: Returns the mode of this colormap.

const QList<QColor> colormap() const.brief: Returns a list of colors which represents the devices colormap for `Indexed` and `Gray` modes.

int depth() const.brief: Returns the depth of the device.

int size() const.brief: Returns the size of the colormap for `Indexed` and `Gray` modes; Returns -1 for `Direct` mode.

uint pixel(const QColor &color) const.brief: Returns a device dependent pixel value for the *color*.
